newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's jobless rate unsatisfactory - Howard.
newsitem.headline: Australia's jobless rate unsatisfactory - Howard.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Monday the country's unemployment rate -- stalled above 8.5 percent -- was unsatisfactory.
"... That level of unemployment is unsatisfactory," Howard told Australian Broadcasting Corp radio.

Howard, pushing to reform Australia's tax system, said tax changes that boosted business activity would help create jobs, along with a range of other government policies, including industrial relations reforms. "Changing the tax system in the right way which boost business activity will obviously have a beneficial impact on employment," he said.

Australia's unemployment increased to 8.8 percent in May from 8.7 percent in April. The government forecast in its May budget the jobless rate would fall to 8.25 percent, year average, in the fiscal year from July, from 8.75 percent, year average, in 1996/97. -- Canberra Bureau 61-6 273-2730
